plugin.name: Calls
plugin.description: Shows your calls and meetings on your devices: the Calls pages during a call, call keys with the call's state, and Back to work. Controls a call only where the call app allows it; Microsoft Teams can only be detected.

permissions.calls: Reads whether you are in a call or meeting and, with your separate consent, asks the call app to answer, end, mute or turn the camera on or off where it allows that. No sound or picture is recorded. Microsoft Teams can only be detected.
permissions.device: Shows the call's state on the keys of these actions.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Answers the incoming call, where the call app allows it.

reject.name: Reject
reject.description: Rejects the incoming call, where the call app allows it.

cancel-outgoing.name: Cancel call
cancel-outgoing.description: Cancels the call you are making, where the call app allows it.

end.name: Leave
end.description: Ends or leaves the call, where the call app allows it.

mic-toggle.name: Microphone
mic-toggle.description: Mutes or unmutes you in the call, where the call app allows it. The key shows the state the app confirmed.

mic-mute.name: Mute
mic-mute.description: Mutes you in the call, where the call app allows it.

mic-unmute.name: Unmute
mic-unmute.description: Unmutes you in the call, where the call app allows it.

camera-toggle.name: Camera
camera-toggle.description: Turns your camera in the call on or off, where the call app allows it.

camera-on.name: Camera on
camera-on.description: Turns your camera in the call on, where the call app allows it.

camera-off.name: Camera off
camera-off.description: Turns your camera in the call off, where the call app allows it.

return-to-work.name: Back to work
return-to-work.description: On the Calls pages: shows what the device showed before the call, and brings the call back after a time or when what you start next is done.

mode.label: Come back
mode.description: timer: after a time; completion: when what you start is done; completionOrTimeout: whichever comes first.

onFailure.label: When it fails
onFailure.description: resume: show the call again; stay: stay on your keys.

onCancel.label: When it is cancelled
onCancel.description: resume: show the call again; stay: stay on your keys.

returnAllDevices.label: Every device
returnAllDevices.description: Every device goes back to work, not only this one.

countNavigation.label: Count page changes
countNavigation.description: Opening a page or folder counts as what you started.

errors.calls-not-in-call: There is no call this action applies to.
errors.calls-unsupported: The call app does not allow this.
errors.calls-unconfirmed: The call app did not confirm it.
errors.calls-consent: You have not allowed DeckPilot to control calls.
errors.calls-pages-only: Back to work works on the Calls pages, during a call.
errors.calls-not-user-started: Calls are controlled only from an action you start: a key, a gesture or the app, not a schedule or an event.
errors.calls-throttled: Too many call actions at once. Press again in a moment.
